review_method: Actual visual inspection of6 statistical PNGs,2 contact sheets showing24 sampled frames,and4 full-resolution near-push response PNGs via in-memory SSH image chunks; no local copies.
scope: Sampled attachment/color/framing and plot review, not exhaustive per-pixel or every-video-frame verification.
visual_findings: All sampled robot bodies including hands and feet remain within frame; no visible detached parts or gross pose discontinuities in the reviewed sample sequences.
Joint colors are visible in both front and side views; camera follows translation and heading; arms/legs remain attached in the four full-resolution push-response views.
Header labels show exact recorded-state replay and correct group/seed/env/view; near-push labels show recovery and actual push times; red timeline ticks and shading are visible.

One initial control-front frame has noisy ground rendering while the robot is visible; later sampled ground images settle. This cosmetic initial-floor grain does not alter the recorded trajectory or statistics.
All6 plots are legible with intact labels/units and no material clipping; frozen contrast threshold and unadjusted confidence intervals are explicit.
physics_evidence: No re-integration is inferred from images alone: exact source-state trajectory hashes, common-step-counter invariance,1876-attribute asset integrity and formal reconstruction audits provide the separate programmatic evidence.
